bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -f "$repo/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || { echo USERBOT_CLIENT_MISSING;exit 75; }
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_ENABLED="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo USERBOT_LINGER="$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN)"
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_MAINPID="$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value || true)"
python3 -B "$repo/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health
echo USERBOT_POST_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo USERBOT_POST_ENABLED="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
